sourceText:
Spinach and Potatoes Gloria's Way!
By: Gloriana
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 4:57pm

Ingredients




1 bag of fresh spinach
1/4 cup water
2 cans of whole potatoes
3 tablespoons of minced garlic
a pinch of red pepper

salt and pepper for taste

Olive oil (enough to coat spinach)

Butter

Preparation

1 In a large skillet saute potatoes, butter, salt, pepper, red pepper and garlic. In a medium bowl toss spinach in water and olive oil. Once potatoes begin to brown add spinach cover and lower heat to simmer for approximately 5 minutes or until spinach is soft.

About


My children's great-grandmother, Noni use to make Spinach & Potatoes often, of course she use all fresh ingredients which, you can too or you can use my quick and easy recipe.
